chapter.verse: Jesu pen Khris hi ci-in a um khempeuh Pasian' sungpana suak hi a, Pa a it khempeuh in Pa' sungpana suak peuhpeuh it uh hi.
Pasian itin ama' thupiaknate i zuih ciangin Pasian' tate it i hihlam, tu-a bangin i theician hi.
A hang pen Pasian itna cih ciangin hih bang ahi hi: Ama' thupiaknate i zui hi.
A hang pen Pasian' sungpana suak khempeuh in leitung zo uh hi. Tua hi a, leitung a zo thei gualzawhna cih pen hih thu-eimau' upna-ahi hi.
Jesu pen Pasian' Tapa hi ci-in a umte losiah leitung a zo mi kua om ahi hiam?
Jesu Khris pen tui leh sisan tawh hong pai hi a, tui bek tawh hilo-in tui leh sisan tawh hong pai hi. Kha pen thumaan thutak ahih manin Kha in teci a pang ahi hi.
A hang pen teci pang thum om hi:
Kha, tui, sisan, hih teng thum kithukhat uh hi.
Mihing teci panna sangthei i hihleh Pasian' teci panna cih pen ama' Tapa tawh kisai ama' pulakkhiat ahih manin Pasian' teci panna sanhuaizaw hi.

Pasian' Tapa a um peuhpeuh in a sungah teci panna nei a, Pasian a um lo peuhpeuh in Pasian zuauphuak khat suaksak hi. A hang pen Pasian' pulak, ama' Tapa tawh kisai Pasian' teci panna um lo ahih man ahi hi.
Tua teci panna pen hih bang hi: Pasian in eite tawntung nuntakna hong pia a, tua nuntakna pen ama' Tapa' sungah om hi.
Tapa a nei peuhpeuh in nuntakna nei a, Pasian' tapa a nei lo peuhpeuh in nuntakna nei lo hi.
Tawntung nuntakna nei na hihlam uh na theih nadingun Pasian' Tapa' min a um note' tungah hih thute hong gelh ka hi hi.
Tua hi a, na khatpeuh ama' deihna tawh kituakin i nget leh amah in eite hong za hi, cih pen amah tawh kisai-in eite' neih sunglam kimuanna ahi hi.
I nget peuhpeuh hong za ci-in i theih leh ama' kianga i ngetsa thute ngah i hihlam i thei hi.

Mi khatpeuh in a sanggampa, sih nading zah ahilo mawhna a bawl a muhleh thungetsak ding hi. Tua hileh Pasian in tua mipa-sih nading zah ahilo mawhna a bawlte-nuntakna pia ding hi. Sih nading zah mawhna om a, tua bang nam' ading thungen ding hong ci ka hikei hi.
Siattatna peuhmah mawhna hi a, ahi zongin sih nading zah ahilo mawhna om hi.
Pasian' sungpana suak khinsa khempeuh in mawhna bawlbawl lo uh ahihlam i thei a, amaute pen Pasian' sungpana suak pen in hu ahih manin Gilopa in sukha lo hi.
Eite Pasian' kiangpan i hihlam i kithei hi. Leitung bup ahihleh Gilopa' khutsung ah om hi.

A maan taktak ahi amah i theih nading, a maan taktak ahi ama' sung leh a Tapa Jesu Khris' sungah om i hihlam i theih nadingin Pasian' Tapa hong pai-in ei' tungah khinkhai theihna hong pia khinzo cih i thei hi. Amah pen Pasian a maan taktak leh tawntung nuntakna ahi hi.
Tanote aw, milim biakna pan kidawm un.
